en.text: There are two contradicting emotions within the human heart. Needless to say, there isn't a person who doesn't feel empathy towards other's misfortunes. However, when you see a person finally able to overcome their misfortunes it is possible to feel a sense of dissatisfaction. To exaggerate a little, it leaves you with a sense that you want to see that person fall into the same misfortune again. Before you know it you unwillingly harbour a sense of hostility towards them.

original: 理不尽な事ばかり言ってると、そのうち痛い目に遭うぞ。

en.text: If you keep saying senseless things, you'll eventually be sorry for it.

original: あなたが言う事は全く信じ難いです。

en.text: It's hard to believe anything you say.

original: 私は彼が私を騙さない事を願っている。

en.text: I hope that he isn't deceiving me.

original: そんな事忘れてしまえ。

en.text: Forget that!

original: この事ばかりに時間をかけてるわけにはいかないんだ。

original: この事は一生忘れないよ。

en.text: I'll remember this incident forever.

original: そんな事するって、どんな奴なんだよ？

en.text: What kind of a person does something like that?

original: あなたの事は大好きなんだけどね、結婚はちょっと......。

en.text: I like you a lot, but I don't want to marry you.

original: そんな事、あいつに言えないよ。

original: トム、どうしてそんな事したんだ。

original: 住んでる街には、いろいろとお楽しみがあるって知ってはいるよ。でも、よそ者だから、そういう事全然耳にしないんだな。

en.text: I know there are cool things to do in the city where I live, but because I'm not from here, I never know about them.

original: よく来てくれた！ちょうど今おまえの事話していたんだ！

en.text: Good thing you came! We were just talking about you.

original: 「トムって、来週会社を辞めるんだって」「おいおい！待ってくれよ、それって結構重大な事なんだけど」

en.text: "Tom said he's going to leave the company next week." "Woah! Wait a minute, that's quite a big deal isn't it?"

original: 事の経緯はこうです。

en.text: This is how it happened.

original: 本当の事を教えてくれませんか？

en.text: Could you please tell me the truth?

original: 私は、あなたの事心配して言ってるのよ。

en.text: I'm telling you because I'm worried about you.

original: これはとても重要な事です。でもまだ誰も口にしません。

en.text: This is very important. Yet no one talks about it.

original: あなたの事、いろいろと伺ってますよ。

en.text: I have heard a lot about you.
I've heard a lot about you.

original: この事誰かに言おうものなら、絶交だからね。

en.text: If you say anything about this to anyone, we're through.

original: あなたにとって重要な事かどうかは判らないが、私にとってはとても重要な事です。

en.text: I don't know if it's important to you, but it's very important to me.
I don't know if this is important to you, but it's very important to me.

original: 頼み事はこれで最後だよ。

original: 奥さんの事、一切口にしないよね。

en.text: I felt relieved when all the troubles were taken care of.

original: 僕はテイルスと同じように、自己肯定感の問題を抱えてる気がするんだ。子供の頃に他の人と違うという理由でクラスメートに嫌な事をされた事とかもあって。でも、良くなろうと頑張ってる。それに、テイルスは人助けが好きで、優しくてフレンドリーなので、僕もそのようになりたいと思ってる。それが僕がいつもテイルスが好きで、共感する理由かもしれない。

en.text: I've noticed that just like Tails, I have self-esteem problems, partly because of my childhood, when my classmates treated me badly for being different, but I keep fighting anyways to be better. Plus, he likes helping and is sweet and friendly, same as I want to be. Maybe that's why I've always liked him so much and identify so much with him.

original: 彼はそのもめごとに関わり合いを持つ事を拒んだ。

en.text: He refused to get involved in the dispute.

en.text: Yuta knew that it was Aoi, not Toru, who had broken the expensive plate at the store, but he understood why Toru had covered for Aoi, and so he decided not to say anything on the matter and keep it to himself.

original: 大問題といえば、今太っているという事じゃなくて、30キロ軽かった時と同じ調子、基本的に同じ速さで全てのことをこなしてることなんです。それが、この体に大きなストレスとしてのしかかってるんです。

en.text: The big problem is not that I'm fat now, but that I'm doing everything with the same rhythm, basically with the same speed as when I was 30 kilos lighter. And it puts a lot of stress on my body.
